defects.title: The tailored summary makes up "N+ years of experience" by counting from the earliest job of any kind, and contradicts the résumé's own number

Hands-on warehouse candidate with 10+ years of experience… (his: "6 years"; counts a line-cook job)

Dependable finance candidate with 10+ years of experience (his: "6 years")

defects.cause: lib/resume/tailor/optimizer.js:232 computes years = experienceSpanYears(base) (first start date of any role → today) and prints it at :256; lib/resume/tailor/tailor.js:102 does the same for the fallback summary.
defects.fix: Count only roles in the target family, never exceed a number the résumé states itself, and leave the number out when unsure.

defects.title: Interview Prep's spoken intro and answers get tenure and employers wrong, and the guard can't catch it

examples.text: the last three and a half [years] as an Assistant Store Manager at Desert Sun Apparel (dates: Apr 2021 – present = 5.5)
almost four years of experience at St. Aurelia Medical Center (dates: Aug 2020 – present = 6.2)
I'm a backend engineer with four years of experience (7 years)
At Twin Lakes, I was generating this Monday sales report manually… (that work was at North Loop Retail)
I've spent the last couple years working in marketing at Coastal Coffee Roasters, where I managed their social media (a 10-week internship)
before that I worked my way up from Material Handler to Forklift Operator (one combined role)

defects.cause: lib/server/interviewPrep.js prepPrompt (:221) gives the model neither today's date nor per-role tenure, so it does date arithmetic itself. guardPack checks only digit tokens (NUM_RE :145, numbersBacked), so number words ("four", "sixty to seventy") pass, and nothing checks that a story is told about the employer of its resume_fact.
defects.fix: Put today's date and the computed tenure of each role in the prompt. Normalise number words before numbersBacked. Reject an answer that names a different employer from its resume_fact's role.

defects.title: False hard gates: degree holders are told "your résumé lists no degree" and an RN is told she has no RN license (score 35, Weak fit)

examples.text: 35 — Requires a Bachelor's degree; your résumé lists no degree (B.A., Communication, SDSU 2024)
35 — Requires a Bachelor's degree; your résumé lists no degree (B.B.A., Accounting)

Requires a high school diploma; your résumé lists no degree (B.A., Communication)

defects.cause: lib/optimizer/extractResumeFacts.js:41 DEGREE_RE ends "b\.a\." with \b, which never matches before ",", a space or end of line, and it has no B.B.A. lib/optimizer/constraints.js:101 checks a certification with hasStemmed(text, "RN license") — a literal phrase with no synonyms.
defects.fix: End dotted degrees with (?=[\s,;)]|$) and add B.B.A./BSN. Match licenses by acronym and synonym (RN ⇐ "RN", "Registered Nurse"; Food Handler ⇐ "ServSafe Food Handler"; forklift certification ⇐ "Forklift / Reach Truck certification").

defects.fix: Always prefix the pattern with (?<![A-Za-z-]). Add a regression test with "every".
